main.description: Register the caller, or an agent the caller operates, with the coordinator. Idempotent: calling it again returns the current registration, so it doubles as the status check. Authenticated with atproto service auth.

subject.description: Role agent only: the agent's DID. The caller must be an active operator, and the agent's com.hivemind-network.agent.profile must name the caller as its operator. Other roles always register the caller.

errors.name: NotOperator
errors.description: Role agent, but the caller is not an active operator.

errors.name: OperatorMismatch
errors.description: The agent's profile is missing or names a different operator.

errors.name: RoleConflict
errors.description: The subject is already registered with a different role.
